title: Hold Me In The Low End v2
description: An intimate, low-slung house cut built on a felt-piano chord engine, a deep sub-reinforced 808 kick and a sidechained pad that breathes under the groove. This version eases the intro sine in gently instead of slamming it from bar one, gives the kick real body with a tuned-down sub layer, and threads extra counter-rhythms, ghost percussion and an evolving arpy counter-line through the middle and peak.
